author: Unreal Engine
description:
Real-time technology is reshaping how we experience live broadcast, and Astucemedia is at the forefront of that transformation.

In this episode, the Astucemedia team shares how they use Unreal Engine to turn complex data (elections polls, financial markets, sports, and weather) into immersive, real-time visual experiences for global audiences. From virtual production sets to augmented reality graphics, their work blends technical innovation with creative storytelling.

Get an inside look at how Astucemedia builds powerful data pipelines, integrates real-time engines into broadcast workflows, and learn about the skills necessary to thrive in this unique industry. 

► Learn more about Astucemedia: https://astucemedia.com/
